criteria.desc: add works, run from an isolated temp dir
criteria.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$d" && PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_DIR" python3 -c 'import m; assert m.add(2,3)==5' && rm -rf "$d"

criteria.desc: add is symmetric, scratch file in a mktemp dir
criteria.cmd: t=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/g.XXXXXX") && PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_DIR" python3 -c 'import m; assert m.add(4,-1)==m.add(-1,4)==3'
